basic_profile.bio: A dedicated Redditor from the Southeast US, I've been navigating the ups and downs of online financial services for years. I'm a night owl, usually online from 9 PM to 2 AM, juggling my day job as a freelance graphic designer. I'm single and enjoy indie music, especially bands like of Montreal. I have a love-hate relationship with technology, often finding myself in discussions about financial platforms and their quirks.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in graphic design, having learned initially through online courses and later honed my skills through freelance projects. My interest in financial systems comes from personal experiences and discussions with others in similar situations.
